name: grim-pastiche-copies-an-action-omen-and-activates-the-copy-free
notes: Grim Pastiche: copy an action omen and activate the copy free. Pre-fix saying yes activated nothing ($copyCardID undefined).

rulesClauses: Copy target non-Skill action omen you have with reserve cost 5 or less. If you do, you may activate that copy without paying its reserve cost.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Grim Pastiche: the generated second handler ($copyCardID) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
